The nominal Pt 83:Al14:Re3, Pt82:Al14:Ti4, Pt 82:Al14:Ta4 and Pt 82:Al14:Cr4 alloys all had microstructures consisting of coarse, primary Pt3Al surrounded by a fine two-phase eutectic-like mixture of a (Pt) matrix and fine particles of Pt3Al.
The two-phase structure in the Pt 83:Al14:Re3 alloy (Figure 2a) was considerably finer than in the other alloys.

The proportion of primary Pt 3Al in the Pt 82:Al14:Ti4, Pt 82:Al14:Ta4 and Pt 82:Al14:Cr4 alloys was estimated by image analysis in the optical microscope to be between 40 and 50%, while the Pt 83:Al14:Re3 alloy had about 25% primary Pt 3Al in its microstructure.
